title: Pasta with Cream Sauce and Meat, Ready-to-Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Pasta with cream sauce and meat is a ready‑to‑heat meal that stays refrigerated and requires only a short reheating. It contains pasta, a smooth cream sauce, and tender pieces of cooked meat, seasoned with herbs and spices. The dish is designed for a quick, tasty lunch or dinner.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The meal is engineered for convenience: just 2‑3 minutes in a microwave or on the stovetop.
The cream sauce is made from dairy cream and a small amount of flour, giving it a silky texture.
Meat is usually chicken or turkey, making the product lower in fat than beef‑based versions.
The pasta is often fortified with B‑vitamins and iron to support energy levels.
Packaging is microwave‑safe, eliminating the need to transfer to another dish.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: The meat provides a complete set of essential amino acids needed for tissue repair.

items.title: Energy supply
items.content: Carbohydrates from the pasta deliver a quick source of energy, ideal for busy days.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: The cream sauce contributes calcium for bone health, while vitamin D aids its absorption.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Meat adds iron, which is crucial for oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: Portion control
items.content: A single ready‑to‑heat package offers a defined portion, helpful for diet management.

items.title: Sodium level
items.content: Ready meals often contain higher salt; people with hypertension should limit intake.

items.title: Allergen presence
items.content: The cream sauce may trigger reactions in individuals with dairy allergies.

items.title: Trans fats
items.content: Some formulations may contain small amounts of trans fats, which should be minimized.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the product refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in the microwave for about 2‑3 minutes, stirring halfway to ensure even warming of the sauce. Alternatively, heat on the stovetop, stirring continuously. For extra flavor, add fresh herbs, grated cheese, or vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in the refrigerator at 0 °C – +4 °C. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container and keep refrigerated. Do not freeze, as the sauce texture may change.
